work.title: Introduce application-facing Git ports
work.description: Define narrow interfaces based on application needs — WorkRepository, ChangeWorkspace, IntegrationTarget — without exposing every Git helper through a generic interface.
acceptance: Application services do not import concrete Git adapter classes
Test doubles can model Work and Change state without spawning Git for pure application tests
Repository-level integration tests continue to use real Git
Ports describe domain operations rather than Git command syntax
No unnecessary dependency-injection framework is introduced
